about_the_game:
Weed Store Simulator allows you to manage a legal cannabis store while secretly producing illegal substances and stepping into the underground world. As you leverage the advantages of legal trade to grow your business, you’ll also form dangerous connections in the criminal world and carry out covert operations. Balancing between mafias, gangs, and secret markets, you’ll strive to make big money both legally and illegally. Success here depends on strategy and taking risks. To succeed in both your store and the dark world, you'll need to be smart and courageous!

Grow your own cannabis plants, sort them by quality, dry them, package them, or turn them into ready-to-sell joints. Every step is on you, every gram under your control.

But sticking to green won’t be enough. For those who want more, the rules of the game change. Behind closed doors, things get bigger: with the production of white powder and blue crystals, a high-risk, high-reward game begins. Everything’s sterile, everything’s systematic. If you know what you’re doing, the business is yours to run.

If you want to keep your legal shop running, selling alone won’t be enough. The relationships you build behind the scenes will shape how your business goes. If things go south with the police, it’s only a matter of time before your doors are forced shut. Turn your back on the mafia, and your shelves might start running empty. Ignore the gangs, and you might not even be able to walk the streets.
